summary.prose: This Story gives every analyze request size a defined way of being handled in full: a size table plus a two-unit input-admission rule decide between one pass and parts, and one shared helper does the part calls, the staged combine and the repair loop for the four callers (synthesizer, free-form lookup, aggregator and step tool). Evidence larger than a call's room is cut into code-point-safe sections that repeat their citation fields, reference context (rules, reuse candidates, anchors) travels with every part, and every failure keeps what was gathered and states what was not covered, down through the orchestrator, daemon and plan-tree mappings into the report head. The build runs from the report and error types, through the table, sections and helper, to the callers and the step tool, and ends with the broad docs regression and the one full sweep.

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: HANDLING_TABLE: XS and S single pass, M, L and XL partitioned, an undetermined measure is XL
decision: the table alone divides (trigger 'size'), the admission rule alone divides a small size ('fit'), both give 'both', a single pass has no trigger

admission for a local model with the checked-in values (32,768 window, 20,480 single-pass output, 2,048 reserve) is 10,240 bytes for a single pass: exactly 10,240 is admitted, one byte over is divided, multi-byte text is counted in bytes; part and combine calls use PART_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS 8,192 and a limit of 22,528 bytes; a window that leaves less than fixed context plus 4,000 bytes gives HandlingBudgetError naming the configuration

with the real code, adherence and docs prompts the single-pass decision for the checked-in local configuration is 'not admitted' for code (10,652 bytes) and adherence (11,040), and admitted for docs only when the evidence is at most 3,916 bytes; every part prompt plus the 4,000-byte minimum room (15,040 at most) fits 22,528
a CLI provider is admitted in characters against its declared budget minus 16,000, and the two units are never compared

the helper calls the provider with {maxAttempts: 1, internalRetry: false} and builds each repair prompt itself: the note is capped at 8,000 characters with the rest counted, every attempt is admitted before it is sent, and a fake provider that would retry internally is never allowed to

repair exhaustion has one outcome: an unadmitted repair divides the part up to three times, then the part is recorded as not covered and the others continue; a part that already succeeded is never discarded

terminal precedence when no part is covered, with failures classified by cause: every uncovered part 'unadmittable' gives HandlingBudgetError; a mix of unadmittable and 'invalid-reply' parts gives ShaperAnswerStepFailedError 'invalid-answer'; any 'call-failed' part (isModelCallFailure, including a Vibe non-zero exit) gives 'model-failed'; a thrown schema-invalid error (ModelResponseShapeError, SynthesizerSchemaUnrecoverable) is 'invalid-reply', not 'call-failed'; each part's own reason is in notCovered and its kind and cause chain in partFailures

sections cut only the sectionable text field, into the largest whole code-point prefix that fits the room: a 6,000-byte ASCII block in a room of 5,000 gives 5,000 and 1,000; 4,999 ASCII bytes then a four-byte emoji gives 4,999 and a second section that starts with the emoji; every section decodes to valid text, none overlaps, none is dropped; ordinals separate from keys

section envelopes: an oversized real-shaped doc.constraint.enumerate record whose constraint text and rationale cross section boundaries yields sections that each carry sourceEntityId, file, heading and kind, whose cut fields concatenate to the original, and that each fit the room (room minus envelope); an aggregate upstream value larger than the room yields sections that each carry taskId, template and params; an envelope that leaves less than the 4,000-unit minimum gives HandlingBudgetError naming the envelope
combine terminates: N summaries become ceil(N/g) per stage and a stage whose count does not fall is a combine failure
a combine failure, including a combine that is not admitted, with at least one part covered returns the per-part results with 'combine' in notCovered and throws nothing
the bundle adapter and the aggregate adapter keep evidence layers and findings exactly, in order, through several combine stages
parseHandling reads a stored {} and other malformed values as absent, and accepts a record with and without trigger

mergeHandling: absent side ignored; single-pass root with partitioned child gives 'partitioned' and summed parts; budgets concatenated and de-duplicated in their own units keeping the largest inputSize, so a local 'bytes-bound' entry survives a merge with a CLI entry; combineStages sum; partitionedBy 'mixed'; equal local part ordinals in two nested plans stay distinct by plan path
mergeAnswerReports keeps its binary signature and prefix behaviour
renderReportHead: a report without handling renders exactly as today; with handling it adds one line with method, parts, each budget in its unit and each not-covered part with its reason

a compile-time test: the bundle handler's call finalizeSynthesize(input.bundle, execution) resolves to the first overload and its result is assignable to the bundle layers; the progress call resolves to the second overload

applyHandling: a single-pass handling with no uncovered part keeps complete as it was; a partitioned handling with an uncovered part or a 'combine' entry sets complete false and adds one incomplete source note 'answer step / <part id>' per uncovered part; the input report is not mutated

failureData: a typed error gives { kind:'answer-step', reason, found, upstream, partFailures, handling }; a plain Error gives { kind:'error', name, message, cause } nested at most 3 levels; a non-Error cause is recorded as its string; the value contains no Error object or cycle and survives JSON.stringify and JSON.parse unchanged; upstream keeps taskId, template, params and value of every output in order; partFailures keeps one entry per failed part with its kind, reason and cause chain

classifyError keeps its prefixes and messages and sets the original error as the cause; the cause chain of 'aggregator-llm-unavailable:' and 'aggregator-schema-unrecoverable:' errors holds the provider's original error; it is applied only to a single-pass call

the part and combine output cap: for a local model the helper passes maxTokens 8,192 (PART_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS) and a single pass passes the configured output tokens; for a CLI provider it passes no enforced output cap and the admission is input characters only

isModelCallFailure: 'vibe exited with 1.' is a call failure with and without the 'structured-output: validation failed after 2 attempts: ' prefix; 'vibe exited with' inside quoted answer text is not; a Vibe size refusal message (InputTooLargeError) is excluded by the division rule before classification; Claude and Codex wordings are unchanged; a schema-invalid reply is not a call failure

classifyError on a single-pass Vibe exit gives the 'aggregator-llm-unavailable:' prefix (previously 'aggregator-schema-unrecoverable:') with the original error as the cause; Claude and Codex exits keep their prefix

selectSharedContext (reference context): for 'adherence' it returns the doc.constraint.enumerate and doc.decision.trace outputs, for 'capability' the capability.reuse-check outputs, for 'code' the anchor record of concept.resolve (anchor.source, anchor identity and, when ranked, hits[0]) as a structural extract, in plan order; for 'docs', 'data' and 'infra' it returns nothing; the returned blocks are absent from the partition blocks; the rule-source count and the rule restatement computed in code match the reference blocks

dedupeByKey: with DEDUPE_KEYS, an entry that appears in the Related docs, Related modules or surface sub-section of several parts is listed once, the first occurrence by part ordinal winning, and the order of the rest is kept

the DEPENDENCY audit: every registered synthesize prompt key (code, docs, adherence, capability, data, infra) has an entry in the table, each entry names its reference blocks and deduped sub-sections or records that it has none and why, and the test fails when a key is added without an entry

reference context in the admission rule: fixed prompt plus reference context plus the 4,000-unit minimum room that does not fit gives HandlingBudgetError whose message names the reference context; one that fits leaves the room for a section equal to the budget minus the prompt minus the reference context minus the envelope, and the reference context is not sectioned

the real adapters driven through completeStructured with {maxAttempts: 1, internalRetry: false}: Vibe, Claude and Codex (CliProvider with the underlying process stubbed) each make exactly one attempt on a failing reply; the CLI adapters are checked for the single attempt only, since they do not enforce maxTokens (this is asserted, so a later change is noticed)

adapter-level output cap and malformed-reply tests: the OllamaProvider request for a part or combine call carries num_predict 8,192 and a single-pass request carries the configured output tokens; a reply cut at the cap (truncated JSON) is handled as an invalid reply; malformed replies from every part through the real Ollama, Vibe, Codex and Claude adapters give ShaperAnswerStepFailedError 'invalid-answer' and a transport failure gives 'model-failed'

a non-size Vibe exit failure through the real Vibe adapter (child process stubbed to exit non-zero) for every part of a divided call gives 'call-failed' per part and the terminal typed ShaperAnswerStepFailedError 'model-failed' with no aggregator prefix; a Vibe malformed reply for every part still gives 'invalid-answer'; the same Vibe exit on a single-pass aggregator call through the real runAggregator gives the Error with the 'aggregator-llm-unavailable:' prefix and the original as its cause

adherence regression with the rule and the code sites forced into separate parts, through the real synthesizer and a scripted provider: the rule outputs (docs/) and the code sites (src/) are placed so that division puts them in different parts; the scripted provider asserts that the rule text is present in the prompt of every part and every combine call, that no partition block repeats the rule as evidence, and that its reply classifies each site against the rule; the delivered answer has every site classified as match, drift or contradiction and none dropped, and the rule-source count equals the number of rule outputs; the same request with a rule too large to accompany every part gives HandlingBudgetError naming the reference context

capability and code regressions with forced partitions: a capability request whose concept.resolve hit equals a capability.reuse-check candidate, with the hit and the candidates in different parts, does not list the hit under Related modules (the prompt of the part holding the hit contains the candidates), and a module seen in two parts is listed once; a code request with the concept.resolve anchor and the anchor's callers in different parts has the anchor record in the prompt of every part and the delivered bundle is centred on it; a file seen in the Related docs or surface sub-sections of two parts is listed once

the ordinary lookup path through the real context driver (steps.synthesizeHandled, applyHandling, settlePipelineOutcome and the stamp callback) with a scripted provider: a successful partitioned answer delivers a bundle whose report.handling is the partitioned handling; a run with a failed part delivers a bundle whose report.handling.notCovered names the part, whose incomplete sources include 'answer step / <part id>' and whose completeness.complete is false; the combine fallback delivers the per-part results with 'combine' in notCovered and complete false; a single-pass answer keeps the lookups' completeness; the model's own report is never used
synthesize: XS or S and admitted makes the one call of today; M or larger, or not admitted, divides, and a failed part is named

free-form lookup: the request size reaches runFinalStructuredEmit through the tool loop; a conversation that fits at size S returns directly with single-pass handling copied onto the report reportFromLookups derives; at size M it is divided although it fits; HandlingBudgetError, 'model-failed' and 'invalid-answer' failures each become a LookupFailedError carrying the tool results, the handling and answerStepReason, failedOutput gives errorCode 'answer-step:<reason>', the failure survives executePlan, does not take the short-circuit and reaches the answer-step failure with the same reason and the report, with no second synthesis attempt
